Squat Snatch:
EMOM 9
3x1 @ 70% -75% // RPE 7
3x1 @ 75-80% // RPE 7
3x1 @ 80-85%  // RPE 8

NOTES:
- There is a total of 9 reps in today's snatch work.
One rep on each minute. You will complete three singles at each weight before moving on.

workouts.title: Extra/ Accessory:
workouts.description:
ROWING INTERVALS.
7 Sets:
1:15 @ Fast
2:00 @ Slow and Steady!
No Rest Between Sets.

NOTES:
- This progression began with :45 of rest between sets and 1:00 on the fast progressions. Now, this week you have :15 more on the fast intervals.
- Start on the conservative end of the fast minute and build only if you feel good. The slow intervals should be consistent but the pace is less important than maintaining good technique and staying consistent from round to round.

workouts.title: GHD Back Extension
workouts.description:
GHD Back Extension:
- Accumulate 50 reps in as few sets as possible.

NOTES:
- Do not try to do a huge set at the expense of form.
Each rep should be deliberate and controlled.

workouts.title: Strict Pull-Up
workouts.description:
Strict Pull-Up

OPTION A.

Accumulate 60 reps in as few sets as possible
NOTES:
- This option is for those who either have strict pull-ups but are not ready to load them, or for people who do not have strict pull-ups and will need to use a band.
- If you are using a band, use as little band tension as possible.

OPTION B.

Weighted Strict Pull-Up

6x5 @ 5RM Weight.
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Max sure that you perform each rep as explosively as possible.
- If you did not do the 5RM, aim for a load that feels like an RPE 8+.
